definitions.explanation: Source material for conversation, jokes, articles, or creative work.
A joke or comedic routine, especially in stand-up comedy or variety shows.
The fish or other topping on sushi (comes from reversing タネ).

examples.japanese: ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ネタ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{尽|つ}きた→尽きる：12365_tsukiru⟧。
examples.english: I've run out of things to talk about.

examples.japanese: ⟦ブログ→ブログ：05104_burogu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ネタ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for material for my blog.

examples.japanese: ⟦ネタバレ→ネタバレ：04763_netabare⟧⟦しないで→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{見|み}てない→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧。
examples.english: Don't spoil it. I haven't seen it yet.
examples.notes: ⟦ネタバレ→ネタバレ：04763_netabare⟧ = spoiler (lit. 'material revealed')

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧ネタ、⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧⟦でしょ→でしょ：10764_desho⟧？
⟦{芸人|げいにん}→芸人：13958_geinin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧ネタ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{披露|ひろう}した→披露する：20927_hirousuru⟧。
examples.english: The comedian performed a new routine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鉄板|てっぱん}→鉄板：14470_teppan⟧ネタ⟦だから→だから：00924_dakara⟧、⟦{絶対|ぜったい}→絶対：00435_zettai⟧⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れる→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: It's a surefire joke, so it'll definitely get laughs.
examples.notes: ⟦{鉄板|てっぱん}→鉄板：14470_teppan⟧ネタ = a reliable joke that always works

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{寿司屋|すしや}→寿司屋：10166_sushiya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ネタ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This sushi restaurant has fresh toppings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おすすめ→おすすめ：09746_osusume⟧ネタ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
ネタ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きくて→大きい：00335_ookii⟧、⟦シャリ→シャリ：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えない→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦くらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The topping was so big that you couldn't even see the rice underneath.

notes:
VERSATILE SLANG TERM:
ネタ is derived from タネ (⟦{種|たね}→種：02157_tane⟧) reversed, a form of slang inversion common in Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:

Material/Topic (sense 1):
- ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ネタ: Something to talk about
- ⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ネタ: Material for an article
- ⟦ネタバレ→ネタバレ：04763_netabare⟧: Spoiler (lit. 'material revealed')
- ネタ⟦{切|ぎ}れ→切れる：01936_kireru⟧: Running out of material

Comedy/Entertainment (sense 2):
- ⟦{漫才|まんざい}→漫才：04458_manzai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ネタ: Manzai comedy routine
- ⟦{鉄板|てっぱん}→鉄板：14470_teppan⟧ネタ: Reliable joke (always gets laughs)
- ネタ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{披露|ひろう}する→披露する：20927_hirousuru⟧: to perform a joke/routine

Sushi (sense 3):
- ネタ: Sushi topping (fish, seafood, etc.)
- ⟦{旬|しゅん}→旬：12716_shun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ネタ: Seasonal sushi topping
- ⟦シャリ→シャリ：noentry⟧: Sushi rice (paired with ネタ)

INTERNET USAGE:
- ネタ⟦{画像|がぞう}→画像：13549_gazou⟧: Meme image
- ネタ⟦ツイート→ツイート：11043_tsuiito⟧: Joke tweet
- ⟦マジ→マジ：04744_maji⟧ネタ: Serious topic (not a joke)

NOTE: In casual speech, ネタ often implies something entertaining or amusing, even when referring to 'material' or 'topics.'
